card.name: Closing lines at the end of web text
card.fires_on: Words and punctuation at a seam where one passage ends and a new sentence or section starts, such as a sign-off like Thanks, a period before a byline, or a bracket before a note. Common in general web text.

modes.label: Sign-off thanks
modes.description: A thank-you or closing remark ending a message or article.
modes.example: <<Thanks>> for all you do through PFLAG.

modes.label: Period or bracket before a byline or note
modes.description: Punctuation that ends a passage right before an author line, credit or note.

modes.label: Mid-sentence joining words
modes.description: A joining word or a word inside a stock phrase in the middle of a sentence.
